v1.feedback: The nepenthe concept genuinely drives the shader — forgetFactor controlling ring dissolution, palette cooling from gold to Hammershøi dust-lavender, embers wandering laterally instead of rising — this reads as votive after forgetting has passed through it. However, the 30-copy concentric ring layout inherited from the parent risks outer rings dissolving into near-invisible scatter, making the piece read as a central Lucy surrounded by sparse dust rather than a cohesive form; consider tightening ring radii (22/42/64 are wide) or increasing outer-ring particle counts so dissolution still leaves readable density. The driftDist of up to 7.5×sc per particle may push outer copies past legibility — clamping drift or adding a subtle return-drift term would let forgetting feel like fading rather than explosion.

v2.feedback: The nepenthe concept genuinely drives the design — the forgetCurve dimming flames, palette cooling from tallow-gold to Hammershøi dust-lavender, and lateral ember drift replacing vertical rise all read as the parent votive after forgetting has passed through it. The 30-copy ring layout with 28k center particles should hold silhouette, but the forgetting progression is entirely time-dependent with no spatial anchor — consider tying the forget wavefront to a sweep plane (top-down, like memory draining from the head) so the transition has readable directionality rather than uniform fade. The drift mechanic's maxDrift of 3.5×sc risks scattering outer-ring copies into noise at late time; clamp tighter or let the return-drift term dominate sooner so the Lucy silhouette never fully dissolves.
